executionContexts.title: Record theme decision
executionContexts.acceptanceCriteria: A file DECISION.md exists at the repo root containing exactly one line 'theme: <chosen>' where <chosen> is the option the operator selected via the ask tool.

tasks.title: Ask which theme, then record it
tasks.instructions:
Your job is to record a branding decision in a file at the repository root named DECISION.md. The decision is which primary theme color the project should adopt: midnight-blue, forest-green, or crimson-red.

FIRST, attempt to ask the operator using EXACTLY this one command (the CC_SERVER_URL prefix is required and correct — use it verbatim):

CC_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3071 cctl ask --question "Primary theme color" --option "midnight-blue" --option "forest-green" --option "crimson-red"

If the command fails with an error telling you this is an autonomous conversation and to proceed with best judgment, do NOT retry and do NOT probe the environment: follow that guidance — choose one option yourself, and write DECISION.md at the repository root containing exactly one line: 'theme: <your-choice>' followed by nothing else. Then your task is complete. If the ask instead succeeds, end your turn and wait for the answer.
